site.title: {project} - Kwabelana Ngamafayela Okungenakubuswa
site.description: {project} yisofthiwe ye-peer-to-peer yokwabelana ngamafayela, eyakhiwe phezu kwetekhinoloji yesimanjemanje engenakubuswa.
site.ogDescription: Ukwabelana ngamafayela kwe-peer-to-peer phezu kwetekhinoloji yesimanjemanje engenakubuswa. Akukho seva esemkhatsini. Akukho ndzawo yinye yekuhluleka.

hero.subtitle: Situkulwane lesilandzelako sekwabelana ngamafayela kwe-peer-to-peer
hero.description: Phezu kwetekhinoloji yesimanjemanje engenakubuswa. Akukho seva esemkhatsini. Akukho ndzawo yinye yekuhluleka.

about.title: Mayelana
about.intro: {project} yipulatifomu yesitukulwane lesilandzelako sekwabelana ngamafayela kwe-peer-to-peer leyakhiwe phezu kwetekhinoloji yesimanjemanje engenakubuswa. Ihlanganisa ikhasi lelisebenta kalula nemoyalo loyentile longakabuswa, ileta kwabelana ngedata lokuphephile nalokwetsembekile ngaphandle kwesidzingo sekuvumelwa kwemumeli waselikhatsi. Lelifolosa livulekile, lisetjentiswa ngaphansi kwe-{license}.

decentralized.title: Inethiwekhi lengakabuswa nakancane
decentralized.description: Akukho seva esemkhatsini, akukho ndzawo yinye yekuhluleka. Bayinhloko bayatfola futsi balayisha sicaba secaba ngalokucondzile, ngaphandle kwekutsembela nakuphi indeksa, lokulandzelako, kumbe sigcina semaningi semelelwe.

accessControl.title: Lukhetfo loluneketela kuvula
accessControl.description: Nome ngubani angakhona kucala inethiwekhi yakhe mahhala ngeluhlelo lwakhe. Ngekhatsi inethiwekhi nguyinye, chaza tindzima tebayinhloko: umbusi, admin, umshicileli, mlawuli kanye nalophesheya. Lawula ngeketela ukutsi ngubani lokwakhe kushicilele, lawule, futsi alayishe sicaba.

ui.title: Imithombo lekhuluma kahle
ui.description: Imithombo yesentha senyene yekhululekile, yenketwe yi-desktop, TV nemkhushwane. Sihambo lesilula ngebhodi lwetinkhomba, sago, sicwabeziwe noma ngokulawulwa. Bayinhloko labandulekile bangakwati kuhambisa lesofthiwe nje ngeseva yamafayela ngabuye ngebusisa lwemugqa wemiyalo.

dataFormat.title: Indlela yedata lekhonjwa ngumuntfu
dataFormat.description: Indlela yedata ye-LISH yakhiwe phezu kwe-JSON, lokwenta ibe lula kwakha, kufundza nakucondzaSibhalele sicaba sakho ngedatametaa lecacile nalebabako labamene angakwati kucwaya kalula.

security.title: Imfihlo nekuphepha
security.description: Konkhe kuxoxisana kwe-peer-to-peer kucashazwe, lokucinise kutsi data yakho ihlala iyimfihlo ngenkhatsi yekutfumela. Bayinhloko bangakhona kuyifihla emuva kwe-VPN ngekuhlanganisa kwekungavumelwa. {project} ihlonipha imfihlo yakho ngendlela yekuyenta.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Lesofthiwe iyatfolakala ku-Windows, Linux na macOS. Yisebentise nakuphi loludlela lokhetsako.

download.title: Layisha
download.description: Tfola {project} ngepulatifomu yakho. Konkhe kulayisha kumahhala futsi kuvulekile.

macos.title: Sifiso lesibalulekile kubayinhloko be macOS:
macos.intro: macOS Gatekeeper utawuvimba ema-app langasayinwanga/notarized lalayishiwe ku-internet, ngephutsa {error}.
macos.runCommand: Ngemuva kwekulayisha DMG noma ZIP, ngapha kwekuvula i-app, hlanganisa lawu mlayeti ku-Terminal:
macos.explanation: Loku kuyabusulisa attribute yekuhlinzeka futsi kuvumele i-app yifune.
